value.title: Michel-Ange
value.extract: Michel-Ange is a French given name, translation of Michelangelo. It may refer to: Michel-Ange Duquesne de Menneville (c. 1700–1778), French Governor of New France Michel Ange Houasse (1680-1730), French painter René-Michel Slodtz, known in France as Michel-Ange Slodtz (1705-1764), French sculptor
